findings.evidence: The locator cites Han-Dong Yang, https://hankyang.seas.harvard.edu/OptimalControlReinforcementLearning/value-rl.html, §2.1.3 for TD prediction, but that section is On-Policy Control; the TD(0) update is in §2.1.1.2 (equation 2.17). Sutton–Barto §6.1 is a separate accurate citation; the Harvard locator should point to the TD section.

The locator cites Han-Dong Yang, https://hankyang.seas.harvard.edu/OptimalControlReinforcementLearning/value-rl.html, §2.1.4.2 for Sarsa, but that section is Off-Policy Monte Carlo Control; Sarsa appears in §2.1.3.2 (equations 2.31–2.33). Sutton–Barto §6.4 is a separate accurate citation.

The locator assigns first-visit Monte Carlo estimation to Han-Dong Yang, https://hankyang.seas.harvard.edu/OptimalControlReinforcementLearning/value-rl.html, §2.1.2. The linked chapter presents Monte Carlo estimation and first-visit versus every-visit methods in §2.1.1.1; §2.1.4.1 correctly covers importance sampling. Sutton–Barto §§5.1 and 5.5 are separate accurate citations.
